items.stem: What did the woman think of the French?

choices.text: They were all good at cooking.
choices.zh: 他们都擅长烹饪。

choices.text: They were particular about food.
choices.zh: 他们对食物很讲究。

choices.text: They were proud of their cuisine.
choices.zh: 他们为自己的菜肴感到自豪。

choices.text: They were fond of bacon and eggs.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢培根和鸡蛋。

items.stem: Who did the man travel with on his first trip to Switzerland?

choices.text: His parents.
choices.zh: 他的父母。

choices.text: His friends.
choices.zh: 他的朋友。

choices.text: His schoolmates.
choices.zh: 他的同学。

choices.text: His parents' friends.
choices.zh: 他父母的朋友。

items.stem: What does the man say about the breakfast at the little French café?

choices.text: No tea was served with the meal.
choices.zh: 餐食没有配茶。

choices.text: It was the real English breakfast.
choices.zh: 那是真正的英式早餐。

choices.text: No one of the group ate it.
choices.zh: 这群人中没有人吃它。

choices.text: It was a little overcooked.
choices.zh: 它有点煮过头了。

items.stem: What did the man think of his holiday in France?

choices.text: It was full of excitement.
choices.zh: 它充满了兴奋感。

choices.text: It was really extraordinary.
choices.zh: 它真的很不同寻常。

choices.text: It was a risky experience.
choices.zh: 它是一次冒险的经历。

choices.text: It was rather disappointing.
choices.zh: 它相当令人失望。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: The woman's relationship with other shops.
choices.zh: 这位女士的店铺与其他店铺的关系。

choices.text: The business success of the woman's shop.
choices.zh: 这位女士店铺的经营成功。

choices.text: The key to running a shop at a low cost.
choices.zh: 以低成本经营店铺的关键。

choices.text: The woman's earnings over the years.
choices.zh: 这位女士这些年的收入。

items.stem: What does the woman say her shop tries to do?

choices.text: Improve its customer service.
choices.zh: 改善其客户服务。

choices.text: Expand its business scale.
choices.zh: 扩大其经营规模。

choices.text: Keep down its expenses.
choices.zh: 控制其开支。

choices.text: Upgrade the goods it sells.
choices.zh: 提升其销售的商品档次。

items.stem: What do we learn about the goods sold at the woman's shop?

choices.text: They are sold at lower prices than in other shops.
choices.zh: 它们的售价比其他店铺更低。

choices.text: They are very popular with the local residents.
choices.zh: 它们很受当地居民欢迎。

choices.text: They are delivered free of charge.
choices.zh: 它们免费配送。

choices.text: They are in great demand.
choices.zh: 它们需求量很大。

items.stem: Why doesn't the woman want to make known their earnings anymore?

choices.text: To follow the custom of the local shopkeepers.
choices.zh: 为了遵循当地店主的惯例。

choices.text: To attract more customers in the neighborhood.
choices.zh: 为了吸引附近更多的顾客。

choices.text: To avoid being put out of business in competition.
choices.zh: 为了避免在竞争中被迫停业。

choices.text: To maintain friendly relationships with other shops.
choices.zh: 为了与其他店铺保持友好关系。

items.stem: What have Canadian scientists found about some seabirds?

choices.text: They can be used to deliver messages in times of emergency.
choices.zh: 它们可以在紧急情况下被用来传递信息。

choices.text: They deliver pollutants from the ocean to their nesting sites.
choices.zh: 它们将污染物从海洋运送到其筑巢地点。

choices.text: They carry plant seeds and spread them to faraway places.
choices.zh: 它们携带植物种子并将其传播到遥远的地方。

choices.text: They are on the verge of extinction because of pollution.
choices.zh: 它们因污染而濒临灭绝。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the seabirds called fulmars?

choices.text: They migrate to the Arctic Circle during the summer.
choices.zh: 它们在夏季迁徙到北极圈。

choices.text: They originate from Devon Island in the Arctic area.
choices.zh: 它们起源于北极地区的Devon Island。

choices.text: They travel as far as 400 kilometers in search of food.
choices.zh: 它们为寻找食物飞行远达400公里。

choices.text: They have the ability to survive in extreme weathers.
choices.zh: 它们具有在极端天气中生存的能力。

items.stem: What did scientists previously notice about pollutants in the Arctic?

choices.text: They were carried by the wind.
choices.zh: 它们是由风携带的。

choices.text: They had become more poisonous.
choices.zh: 它们变得更有毒了。

choices.text: They were less than on the continent.
choices.zh: 它们比大陆上的少。

choices.text: They poisoned some of the fulmars.
choices.zh: 它们毒害了一些暴雪鹱。

items.stem: What does the speaker warn about at the end of the talk?

choices.text: The threats humans pose to Arctic seabirds.
choices.zh: 人类对北极海鸟构成的威胁。

choices.text: The diminishing colonies for Arctic seabirds.
choices.zh: 北极海鸟栖息地的减少。

choices.text: The harm Arctic seabirds may cause to humans.
choices.zh: 北极海鸟可能对人类造成的危害。

choices.text: The effects of the changing climate on Arctic seabirds.
choices.zh: 气候变化对北极海鸟的影响。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the risk of dying for American centenarians in recent years?

choices.text: It has decreased.
choices.zh: 它已经下降了。

choices.text: It has been exaggerated.
choices.zh: 它被夸大了。

choices.text: It has become better understood.
choices.zh: 它已经被更好地理解了。

choices.text: It has remained basically the same.
choices.zh: 它基本保持不变。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Alzheimer's disease?

choices.text: It develops more easily in centenarians not actively engaged.
choices.zh: 在不积极参与活动的百岁老人中更容易发展。

choices.text: It is now the second leading cause of death for centenarians.
choices.zh: 它现在是百岁老人的第二大死因。

choices.text: It has had no effective cure so far.
choices.zh: 它至今没有有效的治愈方法。

choices.text: It calls for more intensive research.
choices.zh: 它需要更深入的研究。

items.stem: What is characteristic of people who live up to 100 years and beyond?

choices.text: They care more about their physical health.
choices.zh: 他们更关心自己的身体健康。

choices.text: Their quality of life deteriorates rapidly.
choices.zh: 他们的生活质量迅速恶化。

choices.text: Their minds fall before their bodies do.
choices.zh: 他们的思维先于身体衰退。

choices.text: They cherish their life more than ever.
choices.zh: 他们比以往任何时候都更珍惜生命。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about most of the experiments mentioned in his talk?

choices.text: They are focused more on attraction than love.
choices.zh: 这些实验更关注吸引力而非爱情。

choices.text: They were done by his former colleague at Yale.
choices.zh: 这些实验是由他在Yale的前同事完成的。

choices.text: They were carried out over a period of some thirty years.
choices.zh: 这些实验是在大约三十年的时间里进行的。

choices.text: They form the basis on which he builds his theory of love.
choices.zh: 这些实验构成了他建立爱情理论的基础。

items.stem: What does Robert Sternberg argue about love?

choices.text: The relationship cannot last long if no passion is involved.
choices.zh: 如果没有激情,这段关系就不能持久。

choices.text: Intimacy is essential but not absolutely indispensable to love.
choices.zh: 亲密关系是必要的,但对爱情而言并非绝对不可或缺。

choices.text: It is not love if you don't wish to maintain the relationship.
choices.zh: 如果你不希望维持这段关系,那就不是爱。

choices.text: Romance is just impossible without mutual understanding.
choices.zh: 没有相互理解就不可能有浪漫。

items.stem: What question does the speaker think is interesting about Sternberg's three elements of love?

choices.text: Which of them is considered most important.
choices.zh: 其中哪一个被认为是最重要的。

choices.text: Whether it is true love without commitment.
choices.zh: 没有承诺是否算真爱。

choices.text: When the absence of any one doesn't affect the relationship.
choices.zh: 缺少任何一个要素何时不会影响这段关系。

choices.text: How the relationship is to be defined if any one is missing.
choices.zh: 如果缺少任何一个要素,这段关系该如何定义。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly talk about?

choices.text: Social work as a profession.
choices.zh: 社会工作作为一种职业。

choices.text: The history of social work.
choices.zh: 社会工作的历史。

choices.text: Academic degrees required of social work applicants.
choices.zh: 社会工作申请者所需的学术学位。

choices.text: The aim of the National Association of Social Workers.
choices.zh: 全国社会工作者协会的目标。

items.stem: What do social workers mainly do?

choices.text: They try to change people's social behavior.
choices.zh: 他们试图改变人们的社会行为。

choices.text: They help enhance the well-being of the underprivileged.
choices.zh: 他们帮助提升弱势群体的福祉。

choices.text: They raise people's awareness of the environment.
choices.zh: 他们提高人们的环境意识。

choices.text: They create a lot of opportunities for the unemployed.
choices.zh: 他们为失业者创造大量机会。

items.stem: What do professional social workers have in common, according to the speaker?

choices.text: They have all received strict clinical training.
choices.zh: 他们都接受过严格的临床培训。

choices.text: They all have an academic degree in social work.
choices.zh: 他们都拥有社会工作学术学位。

choices.text: They are all members of the National Association.
choices.zh: 他们都是全国协会的成员。

choices.text: They have all made a difference through their work.
choices.zh: 他们都通过自己的工作产生了影响。

items.stem: What is Mel Wilson going to talk about in the series?

choices.text: The promotion of social workers' social status.
choices.zh: 提升社会工作者的社会地位。

choices.text: The importance of training for social workers.
choices.zh: 社会工作者培训的重要性。

choices.text: Ways for social workers to meet people's needs.
choices.zh: 社会工作者满足人们需求的方法。

choices.text: Social workers' job options and responsibilities.
choices.zh: 社会工作者的工作选择和职责。

items.stem: What is the aim of Michelle Obama's campaign?

choices.text: To fight childhood obesity.
choices.zh: 对抗儿童肥胖。

choices.text: To help disadvantaged kids.
choices.zh: 帮助弱势儿童。

choices.text: To encourage kids to play more sports.
choices.zh: 鼓励孩子们多参加体育运动。

choices.text: To urge kids to follow their role models.
choices.zh: 敦促孩子们效仿他们的榜样。

items.stem: What does research find about advertisements featuring professional athletes?

choices.text: They best boost product sales when put online.
choices.zh: 当在网上投放时,它们最能促进产品销售。

choices.text: They are most effective when appearing on TV.
choices.zh: 当在电视上播出时,它们最有效。

choices.text: They are becoming more and more prevalent.
choices.zh: 它们变得越来越普遍。

choices.text: They impress kids more than they do adults.
choices.zh: 它们给孩子们留下的印象比给成年人留下的印象更深。

items.stem: What does the speaker think kids' idols should do?

choices.text: Always place kids' interest first.
choices.zh: 始终把孩子们的利益放在首位。

choices.text: Do what they advocate in public.
choices.zh: 做他们在公开场合所倡导的事。

choices.text: Message positive behaviors at all times.
choices.zh: 始终传递积极的行为。

choices.text: Pay attention to their image before children.
choices.zh: 注意他们在儿童面前的形象。
